classification: bounded software integration evidence; not a Mars climate or lifetime validation
initial_climate: uniform surface 210 K, air reference 200 K, surface pressure 610 Pa; flat terrain, no spinup
particle: Ansari 2024 randomly oriented aluminium rods, 9 x 0.16 x 0.16 micrometres
release: 5 kg/s globally, from 0 to 150 SI seconds; double-dose case uses 10 kg/s
radiation: Ames bands; CO2 and dust opacity controls 1/1, surface exchange 1, surface emissivity 1
paired_controls: independent off run at each timestep/layer combination; all start from identical climate fields
precision: JAX float64, CPU; Apple M3 Pro
executed_source: working-tree numerical implementation equivalent to commit 418d20d; run preceded final reporting-only changes, not a clean released artifact
limitations: No complete Mars year, seasonal mean or long-term threshold confirmation
No validation of aggregate optics, realistic dust/cloud feedbacks or physical retention lifetime
Existing GCM budget, damping, clock and PBL PRs are not included in the pilot baseline
Numerical mass projection is diagnosed; post-correction closure is not independent proof of tracer conservation
